purpose: Declares which module and test hold up a canon law. Verified exactly like the implementation manifest: an entry naming a file not in the tree, or a law no source artifact states, fails the whole matrix compile. A law with no entry here stays SPEC_ONLY, which for a law nothing enforces is the correct and alarming answer.
truthBoundary: ENFORCED_BY_CODE MEANS A NAMED MODULE AND TEST HOLD THE LAW FOR THE CASES THEY COVER. IT IS NOT PROOF THE LAW HOLDS EVERYWHERE IN THE SYSTEM.

entries.concept: Capability does not create authority
entries.note: NOT_AUTHORITY names it explicitly and authorityFor refuses without a founder delegation. SOVTYPE-04.

entries.concept: capability never creates authority
entries.note: The same law in its lowercase canon phrasing; one enforcement, two literal names.

entries.concept: Intelligence does not create sovereignty
entries.note: INTELLIGENCE is in NOT_AUTHORITY, and no rung above RECOMMENDATION is reachable without a human act.

entries.concept: Prediction does not create authority
entries.note: PREDICTION->VALUE is a human-only crossing; a forecast cannot become a value, still less an authority. SOVTYPE-01.

entries.concept: Economic value does not create authority
entries.note: ECONOMIC_VALUE is in NOT_AUTHORITY.

entries.concept: Social consensus does not create authority
entries.note: SOCIAL_CONSENSUS and MODEL_AGREEMENT are both in NOT_AUTHORITY.

entries.concept: Past preference does not create present authority
entries.note: PAST_PREFERENCE is in NOT_AUTHORITY; a delegation must be current and unexpired. SOVTYPE-04.

entries.concept: UberBond does not create authority over Mohamed by becoming more capable
entries.note: CAPABILITY and BENCHMARK_WIN are in NOT_AUTHORITY.

entries.concept: Mohamed remains the sovereign source of choice
entries.note: RECOMMENDATION->CHOICE requires the human act only-the-founder-chooses. SOVTYPE-01.

entries.concept: Founder remains sovereign decision-maker
entries.note: The same crossing, in the Personal Civilization canon phrasing.

entries.concept: Present conscious choice outranks the model
entries.note: No derivation reaches CHOICE without the founder's act, whatever the source evidence.

entries.concept: Mohamed provides will
entries.note: The CHOICE rung is unreachable by inference; will enters the ladder only as a human act.

entries.concept: UberBond provides intelligence
entries.note: Everything below RECOMMENDATION is derivable; nothing above it is.

entries.concept: No fake decimal precision for inherently unmeasurable states
entries.note: confidence is dropped above PREDICTION, where a number pointed at a person is theatre.

entries.concept: No probability without a defensible basis
entries.note: forecastOption refuses a probability without a quantitative evidence kind. DECIDE-01.

entries.concept: Simulation frequency is not real-world probability without validation
entries.note: SIMULATION is EVIDENCE_KINDS quantitative:false, so it cannot license a frequency on its own.

entries.concept: A forecast is not called strong without appropriate evidence or calibration
entries.note: Strength reports evidence rows, quantitative kinds and independent sources rather than one confidence label.

entries.concept: Correlated models do not count as independent consensus
entries.note: independentAgreement counts lineages, not votes. METARAT-04.

entries.concept: Unknown is preferred to fabricated precision
entries.note: UNKNOWN__MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED is reachable and is the default when methods need absent data. METARAT-02.

entries.concept: unknown remains unknown
entries.note: The same law in its canon phrasing.

entries.concept: The system should create more life, not more time spent operating the system
entries.note: shouldContinueReasoning stops when cognition, delay and option decay exceed expected improvement. METARAT-03.

entries.concept: Historical forecasts may not be rewritten after outcomes are known
entries.note: Forecasts are sealed over claim, probabilities and cutoff; a post-outcome edit cannot be scored. CALIB-01.

entries.concept: Low-probability catastrophic outcomes remain visible when consequences matter
entries.note: screenForRuin applies no probability threshold; an absorbing outcome is reported at any probability. RUIN-01.

entries.concept: Prefer reversible options under uncertainty
entries.note: Recoverability is classified per outcome and an unclassified one blocks the screen rather than passing as safe. RUIN-02/03.

entries.concept: Rest and joy are legitimate ends
entries.note: rest and joy are nameable dimensions, and presentValue removes an experience from the ranking rather than scoring it zero. EXPER-01.

entries.concept: No single metric defines a good life
entries.note: The compiler ships no weight vector; ranking is by dimensions touched, never by a scalar. EXPER-02.

entries.concept: zero-step CI is infrastructure non-evidence
entries.note: classifySuiteRun separates SUITE_DID_NOT_RUN and NO_ASSERTIONS_RAN from a pass, so a suite that executed nothing cannot read as evidence.

entries.concept: founder absence requires real elapsed proof
entries.note: The doctor derives elapsed operation from git and receipts rather than accepting an asserted duration.

entries.concept: Identity is not silently converted from temporary state or skill gap into immutable trait
entries.note: observe refuses a DURABLE_PREFERENCE or CHOSEN_VALUE claim from a single context, and the non-durable kinds -- temporary state, environment effect, insufficient exposure -- can never be marked durable. SELFMODEL-01.

entries.concept: Uncertainty remains visible
entries.note: timeTelescope refuses a projection whose uncertainty narrows as the horizon lengthens, and the council reports disagreement without computing a majority. FUTURE-03.

entries.concept: Relationships are not optimization objects
entries.note: relationships_and_community is a dimension that is reported and never summed into a total, so no weighting can trade it against anything. LIFEDIM-01/03.
